visual_review.notes: H3 video. The first walk and defend pulsed the background dark with each stomp and the furnace glow, losing most of their plates; both were retaken with quiet steps and a steady glow and come back clean on every frame. The attack skips the smeared frames as the fist swings forward, the hit skips the smeared arm as it flies up, and the death skips the distorted frames as the automaton drops to its knees and as it rolls onto its side. The ladle flames flare briefly three times in the idle, as the glow in the painting does. The walk loops on frames 44 to 104.
